name: Chapter 10: Vector Algebra
description: Vectors and scalars, types of vectors, addition, components, direction cosines, section formula, dot and cross products with projections and areas, and exam-style problems.

cards.term: What is a vector? A scalar?
cards.definition: Vector: a quantity with both magnitude and direction (displacement, velocity, force). Scalar: magnitude only (time, mass, speed, work, temperature)

cards.term: How are vectors represented and written?
cards.definition: A directed line segment (arrow) from A to B: AB, or a single letter a. Magnitude |a|. Its tail is the initial point, its tip the terminal point

cards.term: Position vector of a point P(x, y, z)?
cards.definition: OP = xî + yĵ + zk̂ from the origin O; magnitude √(x² + y² + z²)

cards.term: Types of vectors: zero, unit, coinitial, collinear, equal, negative.
cards.definition: Zero 0 (magnitude 0). Unit (magnitude 1). Coinitial (same initial point). Collinear (parallel to the same line). Equal (same magnitude AND direction). Negative −a (same magnitude, opposite direction)

cards.term: Ex 10.1 Q1: represent graphically a displacement of 40 km, 30° east of north.
cards.definition: Draw an arrow of length 4 units (scale 1 unit = 10 km) that makes 30° with the north direction, tilted towards the east

cards.term: Ex 10.1 Q2: classify (i) 10 kg (ii) 2 m north-west (iii) 40° (iv) 40 watt (v) 10⁻¹⁹ coulomb (vi) 20 m/s²
cards.definition: Scalars: 10 kg, 40°, 40 watt, 10⁻¹⁹ C. Vectors: 2 m north-west, 20 m/s² (acceleration has direction)

cards.term: Ex 10.1 Q3: classify (i) time period (ii) distance (iii) force (iv) velocity (v) work done
cards.definition: Scalars: time period, distance, work done. Vectors: force, velocity

cards.term: Ex 10.1 Q4: in the square of Fig 10.6 (sides a, b, c, d), identify (i) coinitial (ii) equal (iii) collinear but not equal vectors.
cards.definition: (i) Coinitial: a and b. (ii) Equal: b and d. (iii) Collinear but not equal: a and c (parallel sides that point opposite ways)

cards.term: Ex 10.1 Q5: true or false: (i) a and −a are collinear (ii) two collinear vectors are always equal in magnitude (iii) two vectors of the same magnitude are collinear (iv) two collinear vectors of the same magnitude are equal
cards.definition: (i) True (ii) False (iii) False (iv) False (they could point in opposite directions)

cards.term: Triangle and parallelogram laws of vector addition
cards.definition: Triangle law: tail of b at head of a, a+b joins the start to the end; parallelogram law: diagonal of the parallelogram on a and b; vector addition is commutative and associative; componentwise addition

advancedHtml.frontHtml:
Addition of vectors

Add the vectors a and b by the triangle law. What is the parallelogram law, and is a + b = b + a?

Place b at the head of a.
advancedHtml.backHtml:
Addition of vectors

Add the vectors a and b by the triangle law. What is the parallelogram law, and is a + b = b + a?

Triangle law: place the tail of b at the head of a; the vector from the start of a to the end of b is a + b. Parallelogram law: if a and b are adjacent sides from a point, a + b is the diagonal from that point.

Both routes reach the same point, so a + b = b + a (commutative), also associative: (a + b) + c = a + (b + c). In components: (a₁ + b₁, a₂ + b₂, a₃ + b₃). Subtraction: a − b = a + (−b).

cards.term: Properties of vector addition.
cards.definition: a + b = b + a, (a + b) + c = a + (b + c), a + 0 = a, a + (−a) = 0. Triangle inequality: |a + b| ≤ |a| + |b|, with equality when a and b have the same direction

cards.term: Multiplication of a vector by a scalar λ.
cards.definition: λa has magnitude |λ||a| and the direction of a if λ > 0, opposite if λ < 0. Components: λ(a₁î + a₂ĵ + a₃k̂) = λa₁î + λa₂ĵ + λa₃k̂

cards.term: Unit vector in the direction of a; vector of magnitude m in the direction of a?
cards.definition: â = a/|a| and m â = m a/|a|

cards.term: Components and magnitude: a = a₁î + a₂ĵ + a₃k̂.
cards.definition: Magnitude |a| = √(a₁² + a₂² + a₃²). a₁, a₂, a₃ are the scalar components (direction ratios)

cards.term: Direction ratios and direction cosines of a = a₁î + a₂ĵ + a₃k̂.
cards.definition: Direction ratios a₁, a₂, a₃. Direction cosines l = a₁/|a|, m = a₂/|a|, n = a₃/|a| with l² + m² + n² = 1. So â = lî + mĵ + nk̂

cards.term: Vector joining P(x₁, y₁, z₁) to Q(x₂, y₂, z₂)?
cards.definition: PQ = (x₂ − x₁)î + (y₂ − y₁)ĵ + (z₂ − z₁)k̂ (head minus tail); |PQ| = √(Σ(differences)²)

cards.term: Section formula for internal and external division
cards.definition: Internal division m:n: (m b + n a)/(m+n); external: (m b - n a)/(m-n); midpoint (a+b)/2; Ex 10.2 Q15 gives (-i+4j+k)/3 and -3i+3k

advancedHtml.frontHtml:
Section formula

P and Q have position vectors a and b. Find the position vector of the point R dividing PQ in the ratio 2 : 1 (i) internally (ii) externally.

Weight each end by the opposite part of the ratio.
advancedHtml.backHtml:
Section formula

P and Q have position vectors a and b. Find the position vector of the point R dividing PQ in the ratio 2 : 1 (i) internally (ii) externally.

Internally m : n: r = (m b + n a)/(m + n). For 2 : 1: (2b + a)/3. Externally: r = (m b − n a)/(m − n), here 2b − a: R′ lies beyond Q with QR′ = PQ.

Ex 10.2 Q15: a = î + 2ĵ − k̂, b = −î + ĵ + k̂: internal (−î + 4ĵ + k̂)/3, external −3î + 3k̂. The midpoint (m = n = 1) is (a + b)/2 (Q16: (3, 2, 1)).

cards.term: When are two vectors collinear? Test with components.
cards.definition: a = λb for some scalar λ, i.e. a₁/b₁ = a₂/b₂ = a₃/b₃. Three points A, B, C are collinear iff AB ∥ BC (or |AC| = |AB| + |BC| in the right order)

cards.term: Example 21: show A(−2î + 3ĵ + 5k̂), B(î + 2ĵ + 3k̂), C(7î − k̂) are collinear.
cards.definition: AB = 3î − ĵ − 2k̂, BC = 6î − 2ĵ − 4k̂, AC = 9î − 3ĵ − 6k̂. |AB| = √14, |BC| = 2√14, |AC| = 3√14: |AC| = |AB| + |BC|. Collinear

cards.term: Example (right-angled triangle test).
cards.definition: If |AB|² = |BC|² + |CA|² then the angle at C is a right angle (Pythagoras). Compare squared lengths, or check that a dot product of two side vectors is 0
|a| = √3, |b| = √62, |c| = 1 (a unit vector: 3 × 1/3 = 1)

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q2: write two different vectors having the same magnitude.
cards.definition: For example î + 2ĵ and 2î + ĵ (both magnitude √5), or î + ĵ + k̂ and î − ĵ + k̂ (both √3)

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q3: write two different vectors having the same direction.
cards.definition: Any positive multiples: î + ĵ and 2î + 2ĵ

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q4: find x and y so that 2î + 3ĵ and xî + yĵ are equal.
cards.definition: Equal vectors have equal components: x = 2, y = 3

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q5: scalar and vector components of the vector with initial point (2, 1) and terminal point (−5, 7).
cards.definition: Vector = (−5 − 2, 7 − 1) = −7î + 6ĵ. Scalar components -7, 6; vector components -7î and 6ĵ

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q6: sum of a = î − 2ĵ + k̂, b = −2î + 4ĵ + 5k̂, c = î − 6ĵ − 7k̂.
cards.definition: Add components: −4ĵ − k̂

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q7: unit vector in the direction of a = î + ĵ + 2k̂.
cards.definition: |a| = √6: (î + ĵ + 2k̂)/√6

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q8: unit vector in the direction of PQ, P(1, 2, 3), Q(4, 5, 6).
cards.definition: PQ = 3î + 3ĵ + 3k̂, |PQ| = 3√3: (î + ĵ + k̂)/√3

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q9: unit vector in the direction of a + b for a = 2î − ĵ + 2k̂, b = −î + ĵ − k̂.
cards.definition: a + b = î + k̂, magnitude √2: (î + k̂)/√2

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q10: a vector in the direction of 5î − ĵ + 2k̂ with magnitude 8.
cards.definition: |v| = √30: (8/√30)(5î − ĵ + 2k̂)

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q11: show 2î − 3ĵ + 4k̂ and −4î + 6ĵ − 8k̂ are collinear.
cards.definition: The second equals −2 times the first: collinear (opposite directions)

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q12: direction cosines of î + 2ĵ + 3k̂.
cards.definition: Magnitude √14: 1/√14, 2/√14, 3/√14

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q13: direction cosines of the vector joining A(1, 2, −3) to B(−1, −2, 1).
Ex 10.2 Q14: show î + ĵ + k̂ is equally inclined to the axes.
cards.definition: Direction cosines are all 1/√3 = cos α = cos β = cos γ, so α = β = γ = cos⁻¹(1/√3). ✓

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q15: position vector of the point R dividing PQ in the ratio 2 : 1, P = î + 2ĵ − k̂, Q = −î + ĵ + k̂: (i) internally (ii) externally.
cards.definition: (i) (2Q + P)/3 = −(1/3)î + (4/3)ĵ + (1/3)k̂. (ii) (2Q − P)/(2 − 1) = −3î + 3k̂

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q16: position vector of the midpoint of P(2, 3, 4) and Q(4, 1, −2).
cards.definition: 3î + 2ĵ + k̂, that is the point (3, 2, 1)

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q17: a = 3î − 4ĵ − 4k̂, b = 2î − ĵ + k̂, c = î − 3ĵ − 5k̂ are the vertices of a right-angled triangle. Show it.
cards.definition: AB = −î + 3ĵ + 5k̂ (|AB|² = 35), BC = −î − 2ĵ − 6k̂ (41), CA = 2î − ĵ + k̂ (6). Since 35 + 6 = 41, the right angle is at A. ✓

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q18: in triangle ABC which is not true? (A) AB + BC + CA = 0 (B) AB + BC − AC = 0 (C) AB + BC − CA = 0 (D) AB − CB + CA = 0
cards.definition: AB + BC = AC, so AB + BC − CA = 2AC ≠ 0: (C)

cards.term: Ex 10.2 Q19: if a and b are collinear, which of these are incorrect? (A) b = λa for some λ (B) a = ±b (C) the components of a and b are not proportional (D) a and b have the same direction but different magnitudes
cards.definition: Collinear ⇒ b = λa and proportional components, so (A) is correct. (B) fails when magnitudes differ; (C) is the opposite of the true statement; (D) ignores that the direction may be reversed. Incorrect: (B), (C), (D)

cards.term: Scalar (dot) product: definition.
cards.definition: a · b = |a||b| cos θ (0 ≤ θ ≤ π). The result is a scalar. In components: a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃

cards.term: Dot product and projection
cards.definition: a.b = |a||b|cos(theta); projection of a on b = a.b/|b|; a.b = 0 iff perpendicular; a.b = a1b1+a2b2+a3b3

advancedHtml.frontHtml:
Scalar product as a projection

How is a · b related to the projection of a on b? Find the projection of a = 4î + 3ĵ on b = 5.5î.

Drop a perpendicular from the tip of a onto the line of b.
advancedHtml.backHtml:
Scalar product as a projection

How is a · b related to the projection of a on b? Find the projection of a = 4î + 3ĵ on b = 5.5î.

a · b = |a||b| cos θ = (projection of a on b) × |b|. Projection of a on b = a · b / |b| = |a| cos θ: the length of the shadow of a on the line of b.

Here a · b = 22, |b| = 5.5, so the projection is 4. The dot product is 0 exactly when the vectors are perpendicular (Ex 10.3 Q3: (î − ĵ) on (î + ĵ) has projection 0). In components a · b = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃.

cards.term: Properties of the dot product.
cards.definition: Commutative a · b = b · a; distributive a · (b + c) = a · b + a · c; a · a = |a|²; (λa) · b = λ(a · b); î · î = ĵ · ĵ = k̂ · k̂ = 1 and î · ĵ = ĵ · k̂ = k̂ · î = 0

cards.term: Angle between a and b?
cards.definition: cos θ = a · b/(|a||b|). Perpendicular ⇔ a · b = 0; acute ⇔ a · b > 0; obtuse ⇔ a · b < 0

cards.term: Projection of a on b, and the vector projection?
cards.definition: Scalar projection a · b/|b|, vector projection (a · b/|b|²) b

cards.term: Expand |a + b|² and |a − b|².
cards.definition: |a ± b|² = |a|² ± 2 a · b + |b|². So |a + b| = |a − b| ⇔ a ⟂ b, and (a + b) · (a − b) = |a|² − |b|²

cards.term: Cauchy–Schwarz and triangle inequality for vectors.
cards.definition: |a · b| ≤ |a||b| and |a + b| ≤ |a| + |b| (Example 19, 20)

cards.term: Trap: a · b = 0 implies a = 0 or b = 0?
cards.definition: No: î · ĵ = 0 with both non-zero. They can also be perpendicular (Ex 10.3 Q14)

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q1: find the angle between a and b with |a| = √3, |b| = 2 and a · b = √6.
cards.definition: cos θ = √6/(2√3) = √2/2: θ = π/4

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q2: angle between î − 2ĵ + 3k̂ and 3î − 2ĵ + k̂.
cards.definition: a · b = 10, |a|² = |b|² = 14: cos θ = 5/7. θ = cos⁻¹(5/7)

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q3: projection of î − ĵ on î + ĵ.
cards.definition: (1 − 1)/√2 = 0

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q4: projection of î + 3ĵ + 7k̂ on 7î − ĵ + 8k̂.
cards.definition: a · b = 60, |b| = √114: 60/√114

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q5: show (1/7)(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂), (1/7)(3î − 6ĵ + 2k̂), (1/7)(6î + 2ĵ − 3k̂) are unit vectors and mutually perpendicular.
cards.definition: Squares: 49, 49, 49 (all 49, so unit after dividing by 7). Dot products: 0, 0, 0 (all 0). ✓

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q6: find |a| and |b| if (a + b) · (a − b) = 8 and |a| = 8|b|.
cards.definition: (a + b) · (a − b) = |a|² − |b|² = 63|b|² = 8 → |b|² = 8/63. |b| = 2√14/21, |a| = 16√14/21

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q7: evaluate (3a − 5b) · (2a + 7b).
cards.definition: 6|a|² + 21 a·b − 10 a·b − 35|b|² = 6|a|² + 11 a·b − 35|b|²

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q8: two vectors of equal magnitude, angle 60° and scalar product ½. Find their magnitudes.
cards.definition: |a|² cos 60° = ½ → |a|² = 1: |a| = |b| = 1

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q9: find |x| if for a unit vector a, (x − a) · (x + a) = 12.
cards.definition: |x|² − |a|² = 12 → |x|² = 13: |x| = √13

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q10: a = 2î + 2ĵ + 3k̂, b = −î + 2ĵ + k̂, c = 3î + ĵ. If a + λb ⟂ c, find λ.
cards.definition: a + λb = (2 − λ, 2 + 2λ, 3 + λ). Dot with c = (3, 1, 0): 6 − 3λ + 2 + 2λ = 8 − λ = 0: λ = 8

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q11: show |a|b + |b|a is perpendicular to |a|b − |b|a.
cards.definition: Dot product = |a|²|b|² − |b|²|a|² + (|a||b| − |a||b|)(a · b) = 0. ✓

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q12: if a · a = 0 and a · b = 0, what can you say about b?
cards.definition: a · a = |a|² = 0 forces a = 0, and then a · b = 0 holds for any b: b can be any vector

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q13: a, b, c are unit vectors with a + b + c = 0. Find a·b + b·c + c·a.
cards.definition: 0 = |a + b + c|² = 3 + 2(a·b + b·c + c·a): −3/2

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q14: if a = 0 or b = 0 then a · b = 0. Is the converse true? Example.
cards.definition: No: î · ĵ = 0 although î ≠ 0 and ĵ ≠ 0 (perpendicular vectors)
BA = 2î + 2ĵ + 3k̂, BC = î + ĵ + 2k̂, BA · BC = 10, |BA| = √17, |BC| = √6: ∠ABC = cos⁻¹(10/√102)

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q16: show A(1, 2, 7), B(2, 6, 3), C(3, 10, −1) are collinear.
cards.definition: AB = î + 4ĵ − 4k̂ and BC = î + 4ĵ − 4k̂ are equal: collinear

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q17: show 2î − ĵ + k̂, î − 3ĵ − 5k̂, 3î − 4ĵ − 4k̂ form a right-angled triangle.
cards.definition: Same set as Ex 10.2 Q17 in a different order: squared sides 6, 35, 41 with 6 + 35 = 41. ✓

cards.term: Ex 10.3 Q18: λa is a unit vector if (A) λ = 1 (B) λ = −1 (C) a = |λ| (D) a = 1/|λ|
cards.definition: |λa| = |λ||a| = 1 → |a| = 1/|λ|: (D)

cards.term: Vector (cross) product: definition.
cards.definition: a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂, where n̂ is the unit vector perpendicular to both, chosen by the right-hand rule. In components a × b = |î ĵ k̂; a₁ a₂ a₃; b₁ b₂ b₃|

cards.term: Cross product: area of parallelogram and perpendicular direction
cards.definition: a x b has magnitude |a||b|sin(theta) = area of parallelogram, direction perpendicular to a and b by the right-hand rule; a x b = -(b x a); zero iff parallel; area of triangle = half of |a x b|

advancedHtml.frontHtml:
Cross product

What does |a × b| measure, and what is the direction of a × b?

Think of the parallelogram spanned by a and b.
advancedHtml.backHtml:
Cross product

What does |a × b| measure, and what is the direction of a × b?

|a × b| = |a||b| sin θ is the area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides a and b; the triangle has area ½|a × b|. The vector a × b is perpendicular to both a and b, with direction given by the right-hand rule (turn a into b).

a × b = −(b × a) (not commutative); a × b = 0 iff a ∥ b. Example 25: a = 3î + ĵ + 4k̂, b = î − ĵ + k̂ gives a × b = 5î + ĵ − 4k̂, area √42.

cards.term: Properties of the cross product.
cards.definition: a × b = −(b × a) (anticommutative); a × a = 0; a × b = 0 ⇔ a ∥ b (for non-zero); a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c; î × ĵ = k̂, ĵ × k̂ = î, k̂ × î = ĵ (cyclic), and reversed order gives a minus sign

cards.term: Area formulas using the cross product.
cards.definition: Parallelogram: |a × b|; triangle with sides a, b: ½|a × b|; triangle ABC: ½|AB × AC|

cards.term: Lagrange’s identity: |a × b|² + (a · b)² = ?
cards.definition: |a|²|b|². It follows from sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

cards.term: How to find a unit vector perpendicular to two vectors a and b?
cards.definition: Compute n = a × b and divide by |a × b|. The other perpendicular unit vector is −n̂

cards.term: Example 22–25 type: Example 25, area of the parallelogram with a = 3î + ĵ + 4k̂, b = î − ĵ + k̂.
cards.definition: a × b = 5î + ĵ − 4k̂, area = |a × b| = √42

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q1: |a × b| for a = î − 7ĵ + 7k̂, b = 3î − 2ĵ + 2k̂.
cards.definition: a × b = 19ĵ + 19k̂: |a × b| = 19√2

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q2: a unit vector perpendicular to a + b and a − b, where a = 3î + 2ĵ + 2k̂, b = î + 2ĵ − 2k̂.
Ex 10.4 Q3: a unit vector makes π/3 with î, π/4 with ĵ, and an acute angle θ with k̂. Find θ and the components.
cards.definition: cos²(π/3) + cos²(π/4) + cos²θ = 1: 1/4 + 1/2 + cos²θ = 1, so cos θ = 1/2: θ = π/3. Components ½î + (1/√2)ĵ + ½k̂

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q4: show (a − b) × (a + b) = 2(a × b).
cards.definition: Expand: a × a + a × b − b × a − b × b = 0 + a × b + a × b − 0 = 2(a × b). ✓

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q5: find λ and μ if (2î + 6ĵ + 27k̂) × (î + λĵ + μk̂) = 0.
cards.definition: Parallel vectors have proportional components: 1/2 = λ/6 = μ/27: λ = 3, μ = 27/2

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q6: a · b = 0 and a × b = 0. What can you say about a and b?
cards.definition: a · b = 0 means a = 0, b = 0 or a ⟂ b; a × b = 0 means a = 0, b = 0 or a ∥ b. Both hold only if a = 0 or b = 0

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q7: prove a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c using components.
cards.definition: Each component of a × (b + c) is aᵢ(bⱼ + cⱼ) − aⱼ(bᵢ + cᵢ) = (aᵢbⱼ − aⱼbᵢ) + (aᵢcⱼ − aⱼcᵢ). ✓ (distributive)

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q8: if a = 0 or b = 0 then a × b = 0. Is the converse true? Example.
cards.definition: No: î × 2î = 0 with both non-zero (parallel vectors)

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q9: area of the triangle with vertices A(1, 1, 2), B(2, 3, 5), C(1, 5, 5).
cards.definition: AB = î + 2ĵ + 3k̂, AC = 4ĵ + 3k̂, AB × AC = −6î − 3ĵ + 4k̂, magnitude √61: area = √61/2

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q10: area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides a = î − ĵ + 3k̂ and b = 2î − 7ĵ + k̂.
cards.definition: a × b = 20î + 5ĵ − 5k̂, |a × b| = 15√2: 15√2

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q11: |a| = 3, |b| = √2/3. a × b is a unit vector if the angle between them is (A) π/6 (B) π/4 (C) π/3 (D) π/2
cards.definition: |a||b| sin θ = 1 → sin θ = 1/√2: (B) π/4

cards.term: Ex 10.4 Q12: area of the rectangle with vertices A(−î + ½ĵ + 4k̂), B(î + ½ĵ + 4k̂), C(î − ½ĵ + 4k̂), D(−î − ½ĵ + 4k̂) is (A) ½ (B) 1 (C) 2 (D) 4
cards.definition: Sides |AB| = 2 and |BC| = 1: (C) 2

cards.term: Unit vectors in the XY-plane are cos θ î + sin θ ĵ
cards.definition: Unit vectors in the xy-plane: cos(theta) i + sin(theta) j; 30 degrees gives (sqrt3/2) i + (1/2) j; direction cosines satisfy l^2+m^2+n^2 = 1

advancedHtml.frontHtml:
Unit vectors in the XY-plane

Write every unit vector in the XY-plane. Which one makes 30° with the positive x-axis?

Points on the unit circle.
advancedHtml.backHtml:
Unit vectors in the XY-plane

Write every unit vector in the XY-plane. Which one makes 30° with the positive x-axis?

A unit vector r = xî + yĵ has x² + y² = 1, so x = cos θ, y = sin θ: r = cos θ î + sin θ ĵ with θ from 0 to 2π (the whole unit circle). Its direction cosines are (cos θ, sin θ).

For θ = 30°: (√3/2) î + ½ ĵ (Misc Ex Q1). In 3-D the direction cosines l, m, n satisfy l² + m² + n² = 1.

cards.term: Misc Q1: a unit vector in the XY-plane making 30° with the positive x-axis.
cards.definition: (√3/2)î + ½ĵ

cards.term: Misc Q2: scalar components and magnitude of the vector joining P(x₁, y₁, z₁) to Q(x₂, y₂, z₂).
cards.definition: Components x₂ − x₁, y₂ − y₁, z₂ − z₁; magnitude √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)² + (z₂ − z₁)²)

cards.term: Misc Q3: a girl walks 4 km west, then 3 km in a direction 30° east of north. Find her displacement from the start.
cards.definition: Take î east, ĵ north. Total = −4î + 3(sin 30° î + cos 30° ĵ) = (−5/2)î + (3√3/2)ĵ, magnitude √(25/4 + 27/4) = √13 km

cards.term: Misc Q4: if a = b + c, is |a| = |b| + |c|?
cards.definition: No in general: by the triangle inequality |a| ≤ |b| + |c|, with equality only when b and c have the same direction

cards.term: Misc Q5: find x for which x(î + ĵ + k̂) is a unit vector.
cards.definition: |x|√3 = 1: x = ±1/√3

cards.term: Misc Q6: a vector of magnitude 5 parallel to the resultant of a = 2î + 3ĵ − k̂ and b = î − 2ĵ + k̂.
cards.definition: a + b = 3î + ĵ, magnitude √10: (5/√10)(3î + ĵ) = (3√10/2)î + (√10/2)ĵ

cards.term: Misc Q7: unit vector parallel to 2a − b + 3c for a = î + ĵ + k̂, b = 2î − ĵ + 3k̂, c = î − 2ĵ + k̂.
cards.definition: 2a − b + 3c = 3î − 3ĵ + 2k̂, magnitude √22: (3î − 3ĵ + 2k̂)/√22

cards.term: Misc Q8: show A(1, −2, −8), B(5, 0, −2), C(11, 3, 7) are collinear and find the ratio in which B divides AC.
cards.definition: AB = 4î + 2ĵ + 6k̂, BC = 6î + 3ĵ + 9k̂ = 3/2 · AB: collinear. AB : BC = 2 : 3

cards.term: Misc Q9: R divides P = 2a + b and Q = a − 3b externally in the ratio 1 : 2. Show P is the midpoint of RQ.
cards.definition: R = (1·Q − 2·P)/(1 − 2) = 2P − Q = 4a + 2b − a + 3b = 3a + 5b. Midpoint of RQ = (3a + 5b + a − 3b)/2 = 2a + b = P ✓

cards.term: Misc Q10: adjacent sides 2î − 4ĵ + 5k̂ and î − 2ĵ − 3k̂. Find the unit vector parallel to its diagonal, and the area.
cards.definition: Diagonal = sum = 3î − 6ĵ + 2k̂, magnitude 7: (3î − 6ĵ + 2k̂)/7. Area = |a × b| = |22î + 11ĵ| = 11√5 = 11√5

cards.term: Misc Q11: show that the direction cosines of a vector equally inclined to OX, OY, OZ are ±(1/√3, 1/√3, 1/√3).
cards.definition: Equal angles give l = m = n and l² + m² + n² = 1: 3l² = 1. l = m = n = ±1/√3

cards.term: Misc Q12: find a vector d perpendicular to a = î + 4ĵ + 2k̂ and b = 3î − 2ĵ + 7k̂ with c · d = 15, c = 2î − ĵ + 4k̂.
Misc Q13: the scalar product of î + ĵ + k̂ with the unit vector along the sum of 2î + 4ĵ − 5k̂ and λî + 2ĵ + 3k̂ equals 1. Find λ.
cards.definition: Sum = (2 + λ, 6, −2). Dot with (1, 1, 1): λ + 6. So (λ + 6)² = (λ + 2)² + 40 → 8λ + 32 = 40: λ = 1

cards.term: Misc Q14: a, b, c mutually perpendicular with equal magnitudes. Show a + b + c is equally inclined to a, b and c.
cards.definition: (a + b + c) · a = |a|² and similarly for b, c; |a + b + c| = √3|a|. So cos θ = 1/√3 for each. ✓

cards.term: Misc Q15: prove (a + b) · (a + b) = |a|² + |b|² iff a ⟂ b (a, b ≠ 0).
cards.definition: Expand: |a|² + 2a·b + |b|² = |a|² + |b|² ⇔ a · b = 0 ⇔ perpendicular ✓

cards.term: Misc Q16: if θ is the angle between a and b, then a · b ≥ 0 only when (A) 0 < θ < π/2 (B) 0 ≤ θ ≤ π/2 (C) 0 < θ < π (D) 0 ≤ θ ≤ π
cards.definition: cos θ ≥ 0 exactly for 0 ≤ θ ≤ π/2: (B)

cards.term: Misc Q17: a, b are unit vectors at angle θ. a + b is a unit vector if (A) θ = π/4 (B) π/3 (C) π/2 (D) 2π/3
cards.definition: |a + b|² = 2 + 2cos θ = 1 → cos θ = −½: (D) θ = 2π/3
1 + ĵ · (−ĵ) + 1 = 1 − 1 + 1 = (C) 1

cards.term: Misc Q19: |a · b| = |a × b| when θ equals (A) 0 (B) π/4 (C) π/2 (D) π
cards.definition: |cos θ| = |sin θ| → tan θ = ±1: (B) π/4

cards.term: Scalar triple product (JEE): a · (b × c) and its meaning.
cards.definition: [a b c] = a · (b × c) = the determinant of the components. Its absolute value is the volume of the parallelepiped on a, b, c; it is 0 iff the three vectors are coplanar

cards.term: Are vectors a = î + 2ĵ + 3k̂, b = 2î + 3ĵ + 4k̂, c = 3î + 4ĵ + 5k̂ coplanar?
cards.definition: The determinant |1 2 3; 2 3 4; 3 4 5| = 0 (rows in AP): coplanar

cards.term: Vector triple product identity.
cards.definition: a × (b × c) = (a · c)b − (a · b)c (BAC − CAB rule)

cards.term: Component of a vector perpendicular to b?
cards.definition: a − (a · b/|b|²) b: the vector minus its projection along b

cards.term: When is |a + b| = |a − b|?
cards.definition: When a ⟂ b (a · b = 0)

cards.term: If |a| = 3, |b| = 4 and a · b = 6, find |a × b|.
cards.definition: cos θ = 6/12 = ½, sin θ = √3/2: |a × b| = 12 · √3/2 = 6√3

cards.term: If |a| = 2, |b| = 3, angle 60°, find |a + b| and |a − b|.
cards.definition: |a ± b|² = 4 + 9 ± 2 · 6 · ½ = 13 ± 6: |a + b| = √19, |a − b| = √7

cards.term: Find the angle between a = î + ĵ and b = ĵ + k̂.
cards.definition: cos θ = 1/(√2 · √2) = ½: 60° = π/3

cards.term: Area of the triangle with vertices O, A(1, 2, 3), B(3, 2, 1)?
cards.definition: OA × OB = (2 − 6, 9 − 1, 2 − 6) = (−4, 8, −4), magnitude 4√6: area = 2√6

cards.term: Work done by a force F along a displacement d.
cards.definition: W = F · d (a scalar). Example: F = 3î + 2ĵ − k̂, d = 2î + ĵ + 3k̂ gives 6 + 2 − 3 = 5 units

cards.term: Moment (torque) of a force F about a point: r × F.
cards.definition: τ = r × F: a vector whose magnitude is force × perpendicular distance from the pivot

cards.term: If a, b, c are vectors with a + b + c = 0, what do a × b, b × c, c × a satisfy?
cards.definition: a × b = b × c = c × a. From a × (a + b + c) = 0 we get a × b = c × a, and similarly for the others

cards.term:
MCQ: the magnitude of the vector 3î − 4ĵ + 12k̂ is
(a) 5 (b) 13 (c) 19 (d) 7
cards.definition: √(9 + 16 + 144) = (b) 13

cards.term:
MCQ: the unit vector in the direction of 3î + 4ĵ is
(a) (3î + 4ĵ)/5 (b) 3î + 4ĵ (c) (3î + 4ĵ)/7 (d) (3î + 4ĵ)/25
cards.definition: (a)

cards.term:
MCQ: if a = î + ĵ and b = î − ĵ then a · b =
(a) 0 (b) 2 (c) −2 (d) 1
cards.definition: 1 − 1 = (a) 0
(î × ĵ) · k̂ = k̂ · k̂ = (a) 1

cards.term:
MCQ: the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are î and ĵ + k̂ is
(a) √2 (b) 1 (c) 2 (d) 0
cards.definition: |î × (ĵ + k̂)| = |k̂ − ĵ| = (a) √2

cards.term:
MCQ: the projection of î + ĵ on î is
(a) 1 (b) 2 (c) 0 (d) √2
cards.definition: (a) 1

cards.term:
MCQ: the vectors 2î + 3ĵ and λî + 6ĵ are parallel if λ =
(a) 4 (b) 3 (c) 6 (d) 9
cards.definition: 2/λ = 3/6: (a) 4

cards.term:
MCQ: the angle between î + ĵ and ĵ + k̂ is
(a) π/3 (b) π/4 (c) π/2 (d) π/6
cards.definition: (a) π/3

cards.term:
MCQ: if |a × b| = |a · b| then the angle between a and b is
(a) 0 (b) π/4 (c) π/2 (d) π
cards.definition: (b) π/4

cards.term:
MCQ: for a unit vector a, |a × î|² + |a × ĵ|² + |a × k̂|² =
(a) 1 (b) 2 (c) 3 (d) 0
cards.definition: Each |a × î|² = 1 − a₁², so the sum is 3 − 1 = (b) 2

cards.term: Integer answer (JEE Main): if a = î + ĵ + k̂ and b = 2î − ĵ + 3k̂, find a · b.
cards.definition: 2 − 1 + 3 = 4

cards.term: Integer answer: |a × b|² + (a · b)² when |a| = 2 and |b| = 3?
cards.definition: 36 (= |a|²|b|²)

cards.term: Integer answer: 2î + λĵ + k̂ is perpendicular to î − 2ĵ − 3k̂. Find 2λ.
cards.definition: Dot product: 2 − 2λ − 3 = 0, so λ = −½ and 2λ = −1

cards.term:
Assertion–Reason.
A: a × b = b × a.
R: the cross product is anticommutative.
(a) Both true, R explains A (b) A false, R true (c) A true, R false (d) Both false
cards.definition: (b): a × b = −(b × a)

cards.term:
Assertion–Reason.
A: if a · b = 0 then a ⟂ b.
R: a · b = |a||b| cos θ.
(a) Both true, R explains A (b) Both true, R does not (c) A false, R true (d) A true, R false
cards.definition: (c): A fails when a or b is the zero vector (the zero vector has no defined direction)

cards.term: True/False: the cross product of two parallel vectors is the zero vector.
cards.definition: True

cards.term: True/False: the dot product of two vectors is a vector.
cards.definition: False: it is a scalar

cards.term: 2-mark: find a unit vector along a = 2î − ĵ + 2k̂.
cards.definition: |a| = 3: (2î − ĵ + 2k̂)/3

cards.term: 2-mark: find the projection of a = 2î + 3ĵ on b = î + ĵ.
cards.definition: 5/√2 = 5/√2

cards.term: 3-mark: find the angle between a = î + 2ĵ + 3k̂ and b = 3î + 2ĵ + k̂.
cards.definition: a · b = 3 + 4 + 3 = 10; |a| = |b| = √14: cos θ = 5/7. θ = cos⁻¹(5/7)

cards.term: 3-mark: find the area of the triangle with vertices (0, 0, 0), (1, 2, 3), (2, 1, 0).
4-mark: show that î − 2ĵ + 3k̂, −2î + 3ĵ − 4k̂, −ĵ + 2k̂ are coplanar.
cards.definition: Determinant |1 −2 3; −2 3 −4; 0 −1 2| = 1(6 − 4) + 2(−4 − 0) + 3(2 − 0) = 2 − 8 + 6 = 0: coplanar

cards.term: 4-mark: if a + b + c = 0, |a| = 3, |b| = 5, |c| = 7, find the angle between a and b.
cards.definition: |c|² = |a|² + |b|² + 2a·b: 49 = 9 + 25 + 30 cos θ → cos θ = ½: θ = 60°

cards.term: Case-based: a force F = 4î + 3ĵ newtons moves an object from (1, 1) to (5, 4) metres. Find the work done.
cards.definition: d = (4, 3): W = F · d = 16 + 9 = 25 J

cards.term: Case-based: the position vectors of the ends of a rod are 2î + ĵ and 6î + 4ĵ. Find its length and midpoint.
cards.definition: Vector = (4, 3): length 5; midpoint (a + b)/2 = 4î + (5/2)ĵ
